import json, subprocess, sys, random, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/work')
import ref
from compare4 import check

def build(N, nfalse_train, nsrc, B, W, S, nprobe, probe_false, nq, seed=1):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    fields = [{"name":"f%d"%i,"type":"FLAG"} for i in range(N)]
    atoms = [{"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"f%d"%i,"at":0},"right":{"const":True,"type":"FLAG"}} for i in range(N)]
    combos = list(itertools.combinations(range(N), nfalse_train))
    def row(fs): return [i not in fs for i in range(N)]
    train=[]
    for s in range(nsrc):
        rows=[{"t":k,"values":row(c)} for k,c in enumerate(combos)]
        train.append({"id":"tr%d"%s,"source":"s%d"%s,"rows":rows})
    probes=[{"id":"pr0","source":"s0","rows":[{"t":k,"values":row(set(rng.sample(range(N),probe_false)))} for k in range(nprobe)]}]
    queries=[{"id":"q0","source":"s0","rows":[{"t":k,"values":row(set(rng.sample(range(N),rng.randint(0,probe_false))))} for k in range(nq)]}]
    return {"version":1,"window":1,"schema":fields,"atoms":atoms,
            "policy":{"max_width":B,"min_support":S,"min_witness":W},
            "train":train,"probes":probes,"queries":queries}

cases = [
  dict(N=12, nfalse_train=3, nsrc=2, B=4, W=1, S=1, nprobe=40, probe_false=6, nq=60),
  dict(N=12, nfalse_train=2, nsrc=3, B=3, W=1, S=1, nprobe=30, probe_false=5, nq=60),
  dict(N=10, nfalse_train=3, nsrc=1, B=4, W=2, S=2, nprobe=20, probe_false=5, nq=40),
  dict(N=14, nfalse_train=1, nsrc=2, B=2, W=1, S=1, nprobe=16, probe_false=4, nq=40),
  dict(N=8,  nfalse_train=2, nsrc=4, B=4, W=1, S=1, nprobe=8,  probe_false=3, nq=30),
  dict(N=6,  nfalse_train=1, nsrc=2, B=4, W=1, S=1, nprobe=5,  probe_false=2, nq=20),
]
for i,c in enumerate(cases):
    req = build(**c)
    text = json.dumps(req)
    p = subprocess.run(['/app/submission/run.sh'], input=text.encode(), capture_output=True, cwd='/app/submission')
    got = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    exp = ref.solve(json.loads(text))
    probs = check(got, exp, i)
    ntr = sum(len(t['rows']) for t in req['train'])
    print('case',i,c,'trainctx',ntr,'classes',len(exp['classes']),'members',sum(x['members'] for x in exp['classes']),
          '->', 'OK' if not probs else probs[:3])
EOF
